business_problem: ingest customer production data securely and quickly enough to feed AI models that optimize meat cutting, reduce waste, and fit existing factory workflows.
solution_summary: Völur uses Snowflake on Snowflake to ingest customer production data securely and quickly enough to feed AI models that optimize meat cutting, reduce waste, and fit existing factory workflows. Application, customer, event, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so supply-chain, pricing, and operations teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. The platform also connects with Azure, dbt, Terraform so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. With Snowflake, Völur rapidly processes data and shares actionable insights that help customers maximize product value while reducing waste.
